serviciosSeis.titulo: Design, software and AI, from idea to production.
serviciosSeis.bajada: Everything a software company is usually asked for, built by one team in Lima.

diseno.texto: Identity, interfaces and design systems: logo, brand guidelines, UX/UI for websites and apps, and assets for social media and presentations.

web.texto: Corporate websites, e-commerce and iOS and Android apps from a single codebase: fast, easy to manage, with online payments, technical SEO and analytics from day one.

software.texto: Internal systems, dashboards, ERPs and CRMs built around how you operate. We connect the tools you already use through APIs and SUNAT e-invoicing, and modernize legacy systems without stopping the business.

ia.texto: Agents, assistants that work with your company's data (RAG) and automations over WhatsApp or email, plus dashboards and reports to decide with numbers.

iot.texto: Sensors, equipment and machines connected to your systems: real-time monitoring, alerts and dashboards for your plant, fleet or warehouse, with the cloud and integrations that make it work.

cloud.texto: Hosting, automated deployments, backups and monitoring. We look after security and provide support and maintenance after launch.

faq.intro: What clients usually ask us before starting a project.

items.q: How much does a website, an app or a system cost?
items.a: It depends on the scope: an informational website doesn't cost the same as an online store or custom software. After the first meeting we send you a proposal with the scope, timeline and cost of each stage, with no hidden costs.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on the scope. A visual identity takes 2 to 4 weeks, a first working product 6 to 10 weeks and a full platform 3 to 6 months. We work in stages, so you see progress from the first weeks.

items.q: Can you issue SUNAT electronic receipts and invoices?
items.a: Yes. We integrate electronic invoicing with your online store, your system or your ERP: every sale issues the receipt or invoice and sends it to SUNAT, without copying data by hand.

items.q: Can you improve a website or system I already have?
items.a: Yes. First we review the code and infrastructure and tell you clearly what can stay and what should change. We modernize in parts, without stopping your operation.
We stay with you through monthly maintenance and support plans: monitoring, backups, bug fixes, updates and new features.

items.q: Do you work with companies outside Lima?
items.a: Yes. We are a team in Lima and work remotely with companies across Peru and in other countries, with meetings over video call.
Book a meeting or message us on WhatsApp. In the first conversation we understand your business and what you want to solve, and we tell you where it makes sense to start.

vendiq.summary: Online store, point of sale and SUNAT invoicing
vendiq.description: Online store, point of sale, inventory and SUNAT invoicing on one shared catalog. Payments through Mercado Pago, Culqi or PayPal, for a fixed monthly price and with no commission per sale.

rematch.name: Rematch
rematch.description: A marketplace to find and book football, padel, tennis courts and more across Peru. Clubs manage schedules, bookings, occupancy and revenue in real time from a single dashboard, even across multiple venues.

lumiolearn.name: LumioLearn
lumiolearn.description: A platform to create and sell courses under your own brand and domain, commission-free. It includes an AI tutor trained on each academy's content, assessments, certificates and analytics. Built for independent teachers, academies with teams and companies that train their people.

bookit.name: Bookit
bookit.description: Website, online booking, calendar and payments for clinics, salons and studios. Each business takes bookings on its own branded website: clients choose the professional and time, can pay at booking, and the appointment lands in the team's calendar, with no commission per booking.
